newsitem.title: UK: Butte Mining says settles Ernst & Young suit.
newsitem.headline: Butte Mining says settles Ernst & Young suit.

text.p: Butte Mining Plc said on Monday that it had settled its lawsuits against accountants Ernst & Young.
The two companies had been in dispute over work carried out by Ernst & Young at the time of Butte's flotation in 1987 and a share offering in 1988.
In a statement, Butte said all claims and counterclaims had been settled, with Ernst & Young agreeing to waive 300,000 stg in fees for past work and both sides waiving cost awards.
In addition Butte said it had agreed to pay Ernst & Young 50,000 stg within 90 days.
Last summer the English High Court ruled that Butte could not seek 100 million stg in damages agasint Ernst & Young after it had been barred from proceeding with litigation in the U.S.

Butte said that British courts "have not been sypathetic to Butte's efforts to obtain a hearing for the case on its merits," adding that it had therefore decided an agreement was "in the best interests of its shareholders."
